[ASSISTANT_SAID] Day Sculpting is a 90-day program that empowers you to create your life one day at a time.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The program is designed to streamline your efforts so that you accomplish your chief aims in less time.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] By committing 30 minutes each day to create what you want, you can focus your actions one day at a time.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The program is broken down into three manageable steps: 15 minutes in the morning, 5 minutes midday, and 10 minutes at night.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The morning routine creates momentum, the midday routine helps you stay on track, and the nighttime review process integrates what you've learned.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Day Sculpting is based on anchoring, a unique psychological principle that reinforces positive new behaviors.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The program provides daily elements such as the Good Morning Great Day Email, Morning In Vision Video, and Evening Review and Renew Process.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Day Sculpting requires your commitment to your life and is an opportunity to live your dreams enthusiastically.
